sub_graphs.title: EIP-8025: Execution Proof Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of execution proofs from extraction through signing to broadcast

nodes.label: Beacon Block Body Available
nodes.description: A new beacon block body has been received containing an execution payload and related data

nodes.label: Extract Payload and Commitments
nodes.description: Extract execution payload, blob KZG commitments, parent beacon block root, and execution requests from the BeaconBlockBody

nodes.label: Proof Attributes Prepared
nodes.description: ProofAttributes object constructed with new_payload_request and proof_type

nodes.label: Request Proof Generation
nodes.description: Call proof_engine.request_proofs() with ProofAttributes to initiate proof generation

nodes.label: Proof Generation Pending
nodes.description: Proof engine is generating the execution proof asynchronously

nodes.label: Receive Execution Proof
nodes.description: Receive the completed ExecutionProof from the proof engine via REST endpoint

nodes.label: Execution Proof Received
nodes.description: ExecutionProof with proof_data and proof_gen_id has been received from the proof engine

nodes.label: Sign Execution Proof
nodes.description: Generate BLS signature over the proof using DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF and the prover's private key

nodes.label: Signed Execution Proof Ready
nodes.description: SignedExecutionProof constructed with message, prover_pubkey, and signature

nodes.label: Broadcast Signed Proof
nodes.description: Distribute the SignedExecutionProof on the gossip network

edges.label: Proof engine returns result via REST

external_entities.name: Proof Engine
external_entities.description: External proof generation engine that computes execution proofs and returns them via REST API

external_entities.name: P2P Gossip Network
external_entities.description: Peer-to-peer gossip network where signed execution proofs are broadcast

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8025: Proof Relay Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation checks performed by a prover relay when receiving execution proofs

nodes.label: Signed Proof Received by Relay
nodes.description: A prover relay has received a SignedExecutionProof from the gossip network

nodes.label: Check Proof Data Non-Empty
nodes.description: Verify that proof_data field is non-empty

nodes.label: Verify Proof via Engine
nodes.description: Call proof_engine.verify_execution_proof() to cryptographically validate the proof

nodes.label: Check for Duplicate Proofs
nodes.description: Verify no existing proof matches the same request root and proof type

nodes.label: Verify Prover in Whitelist
nodes.description: Check that the relay's public key exists in the prover whitelist

nodes.label: Proof Accepted by Relay
nodes.description: All validation checks passed; proof is accepted for relay/forwarding

nodes.label: Proof Rejected
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed; proof is discarded

edges.label: Data is non-empty, proceed to cryptographic check
Proof is valid, check for duplicates
No duplicate found, verify prover authorization
Prover is whitelisted, all checks pass

external_entities.name: Proof Submitter
external_entities.description: A prover node that submitted the SignedExecutionProof via the gossip network

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8025: Prover Trust and Authorization Boundaries
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries in the prover system including whitelist-based authorization and cryptographic signing

nodes.label: Prover Whitelist Loaded
nodes.description: The set of authorized prover public keys is loaded into the system

nodes.label: Validate Prover Identity
nodes.description: Check that the prover_pubkey in the SignedExecutionProof exists in the whitelist

nodes.label: Verify BLS Signature
nodes.description: Verify the BLS signature over the execution proof using the prover's public key and DOMAIN_EXECUTION_PROOF

nodes.label: Prover Authorized
nodes.description: The prover is confirmed as whitelisted and the signature is valid

nodes.label: Prover Unauthorized
nodes.description: The prover is not in the whitelist or signature is invalid

edges.label: Proof arrives from untrusted external source
Pubkey found in whitelist, verify signature

external_entities.name: Untrusted Proof Source
external_entities.description: Any network participant claiming to be a prover; identity must be verified against whitelist

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define how the prover whitelist is populated or updated over time.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the whitelist is managed through a governance or configuration mechanism external to this specification. The whitelist is assumed to be static for the duration of a given epoch.

ambiguities.text: Provers are described as operating 'without direct protocol-level compensation' but the mechanism for indirect incentivization is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume provers are altruistically motivated or externally compensated. Model them as honest actors following the specified protocol.

ambiguities.text: The specification notes provers are 'a transitional mechanism' without defining the criteria or timeline for the transition.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the prover system remains operational indefinitely until explicitly deprecated by a future EIP.

implicit_assumptions.description: The proof engine is assumed to be a trusted local component that produces correct execution proofs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised proof engine could generate invalid proofs that pass local validation, potentially enabling invalid state transitions to be accepted by light clients.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge BLS signatures without possessing the corresponding private key.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Signature forgery would allow unauthorized entities to submit proofs as whitelisted provers, potentially injecting invalid execution proofs.

implicit_assumptions.description: Whitelisted provers have sufficient computational resources to generate proofs in a timely manner within the slot/epoch deadline.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Delayed proof generation could prevent stateless validators from validating blocks, reducing network security.
